name: ck
description: Code Katz personas and workflows for Claude Code: the product-definition pipeline (/ck:opportunity, market-research, brief, prd, team, roadmap, architecture, brand-guide, design), /ck:panel (three lenses on three models), /ck:plan and /ck:start (a staged plan, then one named session per stage), /ck:do (one small task, quick and in the chat), /ck:next, /ck:claude-md (a project CLAUDE.md from ck's template), /ck:cost (what a session cost, by lane and kind of token, also posted to its pull request at merge), the memory gate (a proposal and your approval before any memory is saved), a team per project (/ck:team invite and drop, kept in .claude/ck-team.conf), and the full persona roster, a complete cross-domain team, as ck:<name> subagents and /ck:<name> switch commands.
